Question: Greta Grasshopper sits on a long line of lily pads in a pond. From any lily pad, Greta can jump \(5\) pads to the right or \(3\) pads to the left. What is the fewest number of jumps Greta must make to reach the lily pad located \(2023\) pads to the right of her starting position?
